summary: First backend testing run for TalentHub. Built pytest suite covering auth (register/login/logout/me), profile update, AI rate suggestion, talent listing, hour packages, Stripe checkout, engagement creation + signing, integrations providers + connect, work upload (xlsx and mpp rejection), and dashboard metrics. All 21 tests pass end-to-end against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Signing flow verified end-to-end including hours_balance deduction after both parties sign (100 -> 90).

minor.issue: In server.py line 579 an extraneous @api.get('/dashboard/metrics') decorator is placed directly above @app.on_event('startup'), which registers the startup() coroutine as a route handler. The endpoint still works because the earlier real handler (line 511) also matches, but the second duplicate route will invoke startup() logic (index creation + admin seeding) on every GET call - remove the stray decorator.

action_items: Remove duplicate @api.get('/dashboard/metrics') decorator on line 579 of /app/backend/server.py (it decorates the startup() function unintentionally).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 579: stray @api.get('/dashboard/metrics') decorator above startup() -- registers startup() as a route.
server.py has 600+ lines - consider splitting into auth.py, payments.py, engagements.py, integrations.py routers.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook expects lockout after 5 fails).
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True which is invalid per browsers; ensure production sets explicit origins.
verify_pw silently returns False on any bcrypt exception -- masks corrupted hash issues in logs.
GET /api/talent returns full profile including hourly_rate for everyone (public), which may be intentional; documented.
connect_integration stores raw api_token in integration_tokens collection without encryption at rest.
test_credentials: admin@talenthub.io / Admin@2026 (seeded). Test users are generated per-run with test_talent_<uuid>@test.io / test_employer_<uuid>@test.io, password P@ssw0rd123. Signing test seeds hours_balance directly via MongoDB.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates one talent + one employer user via /api/auth/register (email prefixed test_). Employer gets hours_balance=100 injected via pymongo for engagement/signing test. Also creates 1 payment_transaction (initiated), 1 asana stub integration + ~3 stub work_items, and ~3 xlsx-uploaded work_items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Signing flow requires MONGO_URL/DB_NAME env exported (or run with env vars) since it seeds hours_balance directly via pymongo; will auto-skip if DB unreachable. Stripe checkout succeeds and returns a real checkout_url (sandbox). AI rate suggestion via Emergent LLM returns proper JSON (low/mid/high/currency/rationale) without 500. All 11 integration providers present. mpp binary correctly rejected with 400.
